title: One Gate at a Time: Complexity Growth in Random Quantum Circuits
summary: A random unitary quantum circuit is expected to be incompressible for exponentially long times. We show that the constant-error circuit complexity of a random unitary circuit grows almost linearly with time as $Ω(T/\log T)$. The bound holds for all $2\leq T\leq 4^n$ where $n$ is the system size, and involves no other $n$-dependence. This improves previous lower bounds derived from spectral gaps and unitary designs by a factor of $\mathrm{poly}(n)$.
